name: Nylon filament for toothbrush bristles
summary: DuPont's synthetic nylon filament put to use as toothbrush bristles in a named commercial product, an early practical outlet for the new material.
description: DuPont synthetic nylon filament used as the bristles of a named commercial toothbrush.
